## TickString

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| `reqId` | `int32` | Unique request identifier used for tracking across EWrapper |
| `tickType` | `int32` | Type of data the tick represents. |
| `value` | `string` | Representative information for a given Key. |
